strings.en: I heard a new mobile suit was brought in... Ah! Isn't this a Zeon...!?
Hm? What's wrong, Uraki? Here for maintenance?
Captain Burning, what is this?
A transport arrived from the Elshank a little while ago.
Anaheim sent it over.
It was recovered when Von Braun was attacked and then restored.
If I recall... a Doven Wolf. A mobile suit like this is a real asset...
I'm more interested in this one, though. The GP03's true form...
No matter how often I see it, it's like a walking arsenal, Uraki.
Yes. With this... I could even take on Gato, guarding the colony...
I know I can win...!
...Uraki, I understand how you feel, but... fixating on one enemy in battle
is dangerous, you know?
I know... but...
On our way here, besides Zeon, we ran into the space pirates the Bunker,
the space crime syndicate Gyandlar, and even that mysterious enemy.
Right... Those skeletal ones, and the ones that looked armored...
Exactly. And all we managed was to make them retreat.
We didn't take out their leaders... This isn't over yet.
...Yes, sir.
Yo! What are you two guys up to?
Kappei! ...I'm sorry, Lieutenant Uraki, Captain Burning.
It's fine. I'm used to it by now.
Age has nothing to do with it, huh? Everyone here's so hot-blooded.
Excellen? Here for maintenance again?
Yeah. The Weiss has been acting up lately.
It hasn't affected my fighting, but it just doesn't feel right, you know,
or it just doesn't fit...
That means the same thing.
You're still such a kid. If you can't tell the difference...
What's going on? Why is everyone gathered here?
Oh... Akira Hibiki?
Just Akira is fine. ...You're Excellen, right? I need to talk to you.
Sure. ...Not here, though. Let's have a chat with big sis over there.
Ooh, what's this? Sounds suspicious!
Come on, Uchuta, leave them be! You make a cute couple!
Huh!? N-no, it's not like that...
Um, hello? I already have a boyfriend?
You're Dr. Tarsan...? I've heard about you from Roll and the others, but...
Indeed! I'm the creator of Dangaioh and the Dangaioh Team,
Tarsan himself!
So, what does a doctor like you want with us?
I contacted you for no other reason than
to tell you what the Bunker is after.
What the Bunker is after...?
If I recall, they're after some kind of energy on Earth...
Yes, that's it... You know that the Bunker has joined hands
with the space crime syndicate Gyandlar, don't you?
That noisy bunch with the guy called Devil Saturn, right?
Yeah, that bunch led by Devil Saturn 6, who never learns his lesson.
Precisely. And the aim of those Gyandlar
is a mystical power called Hyper Libido.
Hyper... Libido?
I've never heard of it... What is it like?
There's a record of it being used just once before, on planet Cronos.
They say its power even corrected the tilt in the planet's axis.
Planet Cronos... That's Rom's home world!
Indeed. Defeated in that battle, Gyandlar left planet Cronos behind
and came all the way to the solar system. ...Why do you think that is?
Wasn't it just by chance?
No... From the way Dr. Tarsan is talking...
they came to Earth looking for this Hyper Libido thing...
Correct. You've a deeper mind than that brat over there, young man.
Shut up, old geezer! I've got a name, and it's Kappei Jin!
Besides, we've never heard of any Hyper Libido in our whole lives!
Ho ho, full of spirit, aren't you... You're right about that, though.
There's probably no Hyper Libido on Earth.
But what about something that could take its place...?
Hmm... Earth does have many special energy sources...
But one strong enough to fix a planet's axis...
What Gyandlar is after... is probably the thing that, on Earth,
goes by the name of Mutron.
What!? They're after the Mutron?
Hey, speaking of Mutron... isn't that Raideen's...
Yes, it's the source of Raideen's power, I think.
Mutron...? I've heard of it. ...If I remember...
Tetsuya, it's Raideen.
Raideen's power source is... Mutron energy, I think...
Oh my, it seems Earth already has machines that run on Mutron...
Well, anyway, Mutron is said to be a mysterious power like Hyper Libido,
with tremendous strength.
Well, Raideen does have something mystical about it.
Whatever the case, it mustn't fall into Gyandlar's... no, the Bunker's hands!
I have a terribly bad feeling about this.
I understand. We'll pass this on to our comrades on the surface.
Thank you for the information.
Not at all. You've been taking care of the Dangaioh Team,
so I'm glad if I can be of even a little help.
(Besides, with them in my debt, callin' Mia and the others back'll be easier,
and I might even get a taste of that Mutron...)
Dr. Tarsan, you've done so much for us... I don't know how to thank you.
...All we've faced are villains like the Vega Star Federation, who trample
and exploit others for their own selfish greed.
I'm truly grateful to have an ally like you, Doctor.
Urk... Th-that's right! I hate the Bunker too, you know.
Ha ha, ha ha ha.
Thank you, Doctor. ...I'd like to have a long talk once this battle is over.
...Provided you stick with us to the very end, that is.
O-of course I will! Leave it all to me!
(Hmm... These two... They're hard to deal with.
One's naive... and the other, I can't read at all
what he's thinking. Hmmm...)
Damn, we finally got all this info...!
But I can't stop worrying about the surface... I wanna go back too...
Hey, Lenny, can our machines break through the atmosphere?
...Hmm, I wonder. The Sky Demon might manage, but...
I'd rather not burn up, Big Bro.
Oh, it seems you have a problem.
If that's the case... I'm actually headed your way myself.
Once we meet up, I wouldn't mind sending you down with my warp beam.
All right! Thanks, old man, you're a lifesaver!
A warp beam...!
(That's it, the warp beam...!)
You've done so much for us. ...Sorry to impose, but please do.
Now, now, it's no trouble. I'm a lover of justice too, after all!
Well then, see you later.
Dr. Tarsan!
Hm, what is it? Oh, Mia! Don't tell me you're coming back...
...We want to go down to Earth too.
...Please use the warp beam to send us too, along with Joe and the others,
down to the surface!
Hey, lady, what do you...
Joe! She must have something in mind, don't you think?
Wh-what did you say!?
No way...! What about stopping the colony drop?
Well said, Mia! Now that we know the Bunker's aim, I can't just sit still!
...Earth has lots of special energy, like Photon Power and Getter Rays...
If the space pirates the Bunker, no, if Gil Berg stole something like that...
Stopping the colony drop matters, but the Bunker
getting their hands on that would be a huge problem too. Hmm...
Losing Dangaioh would be rough in its own way, though...
In the end, the ones who know the Bunker best
are the Dangaioh Team, right? Why not let them go?
Stopping the colony won't help if the Bunker gets some crazy power.
I say let them go. To make up for losing Dangaioh,
those of us who stay just have to work harder.
Besides... even if we stop the colony, if the Bunker
gets hold of some incredible power, it'll be hard to turn things around.
True. They know more about the Bunker than anyone...
...All right. Honestly, I'd like you to stay, but...
the Dangaioh Team was never enlisted in the military to begin with.
Captain Bright, then...!
Yes. Go after the Bunker and stop their plans.
Thank you very much!
It seems nothing I say will change your minds... Well, I'll be waiting.
If you run into old man Hazuki, tell him I said hi.
Sure thing. With you guys gone, he's probably got fewer gray hairs.
I hope so. ...Though I kinda doubt it.
If that's settled, let's hurry up and get to that old man!
Hey, that old man's awfully nice, but...
Yeah, yeah, there's something fishy about him.
...That type is totally scheming something behind the scenes...
Considering who we'll be up against from here on, a bit of calculation...
will work in our favor.
And thanks to Umon, he's been put on notice.
Is that red unit still showing up on the surface too?
Yes. And every time, Kyosuke says he can "hear a voice."
Raideen reacts to it, too.
What on earth are those things?
The red one in particular seems to have a pilot aboard...
...I don't know. Sorry, Akira.
No... but... you should be careful. You and Kyosuke...
Could you have some deep connection with them?
That's what I'd like to know.
...If it's asking me on a date, I wish it'd just be upfront about it...
(Kyosuke... You, me, and that girl... Something feels wrong...)
It's finally time...
It seems we... made it in time.
Though we sure went through hell to get here.
Anyway, we met up with Akira and the others, so I'll call it good.
Yeah, and in the end we made it to the colony in time.
Honestly, "barely made it" is more like it.
Sounds like Daisuke had a rough time of it, too.
Well, we met up with Akira's group, so all's well that ends well, right?
Right. For now... things are going our way.
By the way, where'd that shady doctor run off to?
It sounds like he sent Joe and the others to Earth...
With a warp beam, he said. Handy ray, huh?
He said he'd track the Bunker on his own, then vanished right away...
He's definitely suspicious...
Nah, back when I was a junk dealer, there were shady old guys like him...
but that one's not rotten to the core.
At the very least, for now he's definitely cooperating with us.
Right now, we need every ally we can get.
Our forces are coming together... Things are starting to look up.
And we successfully retrieved the Dendrobium.
But... even if we stop the colony, we have a mountain of problems...
The Gaizok, the Crossbone Vanguard... none of it's settled yet...
Emma, let's save the complicated stuff for later, OK? Colony first.
The colony comes first, right, Lieutenant? One thing at a time.
Exactly.
Even if we were to fall to the Gaizok or the Bunker...
there would still be the Gandor Team... Amuro and the others.
But we're the only ones who can stop the colony now.
Hey, hey, Captain! Don't talk about losing, not even as a joke!
We're gonna handle space ourselves!
Yes, I can't have you talking like that, Captain.
...My apologies. ...Hm?
Captain, it seems we're receiving a request for permission to land?
What? ...This is... the Elshank's transport...?
Phew... What a pain. Why do we gotta go out there?
So the treasure's real, but ain't Lady Diondra rushin' it?
Boss Gil Berg's already on it, so who cares?
...Forget that, droppin' the colony on Earth'd be way more fun.
I won't let you... Devil Saturn 6...!
Wh-what the!? I was finally gettin' in a good mood, so don't spoil it!
I won't let you pass... beyond this point.
Rom Stol! How long are ya gonna keep gettin' in my way!?
Until you lot are gone from this universe.
The people of Earth will take care of Earth! Stay out of the way!
Exactly.
What're ya yappin' about!? Let 'em have it!
And then we'll watch the colony drop from front-row seats!
I said we won't let you!
I won't let you...! Heaven, earth, fire, water... grant me power...!
Oh, there it is. Is that the colony!?
It's huge... Obviously, but up close it's amazing. Can we stop it?
What good is getting cold feet now? We have no choice but to do it.
Daisuke's right, see? Where there's a will, there's a way!
...It's closer than expected... We have almost no time.
Heh, no matter how many enemies there are, 30 minutes is plenty.
Thirty or forty minutes will do. Scatter them and grab the colony.
Captain?
...? Hey, don't you have a bad feeling about this, Kappei?
Bright's pretty easy to read, after all.
...No, it's nothing. Everyone, return to your stations.
Understood! All right, let's do this...! This is why I came to space.
But losing the Dangaioh Team at this point hurts.
Lenny and them were a special case, but now these guys left too.
Things are moving on the surface too, so it can't be helped.
Well, they were cheerful girls, so it's a little lonely.
More like flashy than cheerful.
...With them wandering around dressed like that, I couldn't relax.
Oh my... Maybe I should strip down for the team? Like, whoosh...
...Don't even think about it.
Don't ask me to join in, 'cause I won't.
I don't really mind, but...
No good, huh? We're still one short.
...Maybe the Nadesico's captain would say yes?
Is this a time for jokes? The Captain's gonna correct you, you know.
It's better than everyone being oddly tense. Besides, I'm used to it.
An ordinary army might not be enough for you anymore, Captain.
Not that I could let Amuro or Kamille see this.
Really? ...The Gandor Team wasn't all that different.
I agree.
Oh, there you are! Judau!
Ple!? You came out here!?
Judau! I missed you so much! Judau!
Elpeo Ple!? How did you get here!?
I woke up at Anaheim, so I asked this lady, Princess Romina,
to let me ride on the supply ship! Judau, I'll fight too!
I'm gonna beat up all the bad guys!
A welcome boost to our strength, just in the nick of time.
Huh? ...This feeling... You're...
Oh, this is Ple Two.
But you two look so much alike, just like twins!
Stop it! I am who I am!
(Haman... Has she stooped to cloning Cyber-Newtypes...?
No... that woman would be capable of it...)
...Yeah... Ple is Ple, and Ple Two is Ple Two, right...?
I'm Elpeo Ple. Ple Two, you like Judau too, right?
Ahah, I knew it! Then we're friends!
Fr...ie...nds...?
Yeah! Ple and Ple Two are friends! Let's help Judau together!
Big Bro Judau sure is popular with the girls.
Oh, Kappei, is Ple your type?
N-no way!
(...So children have the power to turn petty grudges into friendship...
Amuro, perhaps we really are old-fashioned Newtypes.)
Right... It's time. The Ra Cailum is now entering the combat zone!
All hands, stand by at your posts! Stay sharp!
